aliasing_method: seeded base order followed by cyclic alternation across case-replicate packets
alias_balance_rule: With nine pairs, the two condition counts per alias differ by exactly one; each case has a 2:1 or 1:2 split.
retry_rule: HTTP/API failures stop; only structurally invalid HTTP-200 output receives one unchanged-content retry.
candidate_body_policy: frozen build_blind_packets.clean_final; final moderator output only
judge_task_policy: the identical frozen neutral de-leaked debate_topic is used for both anonymous candidates; original solution-cue prompt is never sent to the judge
analysis_unit: case mean after averaging three replicates; n=3 independent cases
scoring_protocol_change: none; only candidate cardinality changes from the previous official Pass 1 implementations to A-B
target_recovery_policy: separate auxiliary audit using protocol/prompt_deleaking_target_recovery_rubric_v1.md, never added to IHQ
